review_evidence: README identifies l4v as the L4.verified repository of formal specifications and Isabelle/HOL proofs for the seL4 microkernel, with abstract, Haskell, machine, C, capDL, take-grant and refinement/security developments.
The reviewed unit has 1,883 current-primary Isabelle theories spanning specifications, refinement, access-control/infoflow proofs, system initialization, libraries and C/assembly proof tooling.

Example/test/tool-named theories were conservatively retained: inspected paths include separation-logic examples, Eisbach/ML tactic tests and proof/refinement examples, which exercise or state formal proof-tool semantics rather than forming a demonstrably lossless generated/report layer.
summary: Retain the full seL4 l4v Isabelle unit, including proof-tool examples and regression theories, because the repository is itself a large formal specification and verification development.
